007package com.oracle.database.selectai.samples.conversation;
008
009import com.oracle.database.selectai.Conversation;
010import com.oracle.database.selectai.SelectAI;
011import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.DbConnectionConfig;
012import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.SelectAIException;
013import org.slf4j.Logger;
014import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
015
016/**
017 * Sample for deleting one prompt from a Select AI conversation.
018 *
019 * <p>This sample changes database state by calling
020 * {@link Conversation#deletePrompt(String, boolean)} for the prompt identified
021 * by {@code SELECTAI_CONVERSATION_PROMPT_ID}. Verify the prompt ID before
022 * running it.</p>
023 *
024 * <p>To run this sample, provide an existing conversation prompt identifier
025 * through {@code SELECTAI_CONVERSATION_PROMPT_ID}. The integration script skips
026 * prompt deletion when no prompt ID is available.</p>
027 *
028 * <p>Required environment variables:</p>
029 * <ul>
030 *   <li>SELECTAI_DB_USER</li>
031 *   <li>SELECTAI_DB_PASSWORD</li>
032 *   <li>SELECTAI_JDBC_URL</li>
033 *   <li>SELECTAI_CONVERSATION_ID</li>
034 *   <li>SELECTAI_CONVERSATION_PROMPT_ID</li>
035 * </ul>
036 *
037 * <p>Optional environment variables:</p>
038 * <ul>
039 *   <li>SELECTAI_CONVERSATION_PROMPT_DELETE_FORCE - defaults to {@code false}.</li>
040 * </ul>
041 *
042 * <p>Before compiling or running this sample, build the SDK jar and copy runtime
043 * dependencies. Run the dependency copy command after {@code mvn clean install},
044 * because Maven {@code clean} removes the {@code target/} directory.</p>
045 * <pre>{@code
046 * mvn clean install
047 * mvn -Psamples -DincludeScope=runtime -DoutputDirectory=target/dependency dependency:copy-dependencies
048 * }</pre>
049 *
050 * <p>Compile this sample:</p>
051 * <pre>{@code
052 * javac --release 17 -cp "target/select-ai-java-1.0.0.jar:target/dependency/*" \
053 *   -d samples/out \
054 *   samples/src/main/java/com/oracle/database/selectai/samples/conversation/DeleteConversationPromptSample.java
055 * }</pre>
056 *
057 * <p>Run this sample:</p>
058 * <pre>{@code
059 * java -cp "samples/out:target/select-ai-java-1.0.0.jar:target/dependency/*" \
060 *   com.oracle.database.selectai.samples.conversation.DeleteConversationPromptSample
061 * }</pre>
062 */
063public final class DeleteConversationPromptSample {
064    private static final Logger LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(DeleteConversationPromptSample.class);
065
066    private DeleteConversationPromptSample() {
067    }
068
069    public static void main(String[] args) {
070        String conversationId = requiredEnv("SELECTAI_CONVERSATION_ID");
071        String conversationPromptId = requiredEnv("SELECTAI_CONVERSATION_PROMPT_ID");
072        boolean force = Boolean.parseBoolean(envOrDefault("SELECTAI_CONVERSATION_PROMPT_DELETE_FORCE", "false"));
073
074        try {
075            SelectAI selectAI = createSelectAI();
076            Conversation conversation = selectAI.conversation(conversationId);
077            boolean deleted = conversation.deletePrompt(conversationPromptId, force);
078
079            System.out.printf("Conversation ID : %s%n", conversation.getConversationId());
080            System.out.printf("Prompt ID       : %s%n", conversationPromptId);
081            System.out.printf("Deleted         : %s%n", deleted);
082        } catch (SelectAIException e) {
083            LOGGER.error("Failed to delete prompt '{}' for Select AI conversation '{}'.",
084                    conversationPromptId, conversationId, e);
085        }
086    }
087
088    private static SelectAI createSelectAI() throws SelectAIException {
089        DbConnectionConfig dbConnectionConfig = DbConnectionConfig.builder()
090                .dbUser(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_DB_USER"))
091                .dbPassword(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_DB_PASSWORD"))
092                .jdbcUrl(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_JDBC_URL"))
093                .build();
094
095        return SelectAI.create(dbConnectionConfig);
096    }
097
098    private static String requiredEnv(String name) {
099        String value = System.getenv(name);
100        if (value == null || value.isBlank()) {
101            throw new IllegalStateException("Missing required environment variable: " + name);
102        }
103        return value;
104    }
105
106    private static String envOrDefault(String name, String defaultValue) {
107        String value = System.getenv(name);
108        return value == null || value.isBlank() ? defaultValue : value;
109    }
110}
